    Lifting a graded module to ℤ/4 (Proposition 10.1) #

    integral-deformations.tex: "Lift the action matrices arbitrarily to free graded 𝒪-modules. Their associativity defect is even. Division by two, followed by reduction, gives an Ext² class of degree zero. … Since (2𝒪)² = 0, this single correction makes the action associative."

    For a graded Λ-module M with a homogeneous basis β and Ext²_0(M, M) = 0, the free module ι → 𝒪 carries a graded Λ̃-action lifting that of M (exists_liftMod). The unit is automatic: the action of 1 is an idempotent congruent to the identity.

    The free lift of a graded module with a homogeneous basis #
